# Submit team expenses and let a reviewer approve or reject them. @{nl="Dien teamonkosten in en laat een beoordelaar ze goedkeuren of afwijzen."}
app ExpenseFlow uses=[expenses,reporting]
package expenses
 Given
  preferences { status:Expense.status? }
  message label_Expense_decision_note = "Decision note"@{nl="Toelichting op het besluit"}
  role reviewer label="Reviewer"@{nl="Beoordelaar"}
  export Expense {
   purpose:text trim max=300 label="Expense purpose"@{nl="Doel van de onkost"},
   amount:money,
   submitted_by:user server=actor label="Submitted by"@{nl="Ingediend door"},
   status:enum(draft,submitted,approved,rejected)=draft label={text="Status"@{nl="Status"},values={draft="Draft"@{nl="Concept"},submitted="Submitted"@{nl="Ingediend"},approved="Approved"@{nl="Goedgekeurd"},rejected="Rejected"@{nl="Afgewezen"}}},
   decision_note:text? label=label_Expense_decision_note,
   decided_by:user? label="Decided by"@{nl="Besloten door"},
   decided_at:datetime?
 label="Decided at"@{nl="Besloten op"}  } label="Expense"@{nl="Onkost"}
  policy Expense read=members where=row.submitted_by==actor
  policy Expense read=reviewer
  invariant Expense: row.amount.minor>0
  lock Expense fields=purpose,amount,submitted_by when=row.status!=draft
  lock Expense fields=status,decision_note,decided_by,decided_at when=row.status in [approved,rejected]
  fixture reviewer_one=user {roles=[reviewer]}
  fixture reviewer_two=user {roles=[reviewer]}
  fixture pending=Expense {purpose="Travel",amount=money(25,"EUR"),submitted_by=other,status=submitted}
 When
  crud Expense by=members fields=purpose,amount when=row.submitted_by==actor and row.status==draft delete=none
  # Submit your own draft expense for review. @{nl="Dien je eigen conceptonkost ter beoordeling in."}
  scenario submit(expense:Expense) by=members
   require expense.submitted_by==actor and expense.status==draft
   do set expense {status=submitted}
   ## Grants belong to two noncalling same-team accounts; claimant is other.
   ## This checks one submission, not a shared-state multi-operation journey.
   examples expense=pending seed=[reviewer_one,reviewer_two]
    as,expense.status -> expense.status,reviewer(reviewer_one),reviewer(reviewer_two),reviewer_one!=reviewer_two,expense.submitted_by!=reviewer_one,expense.submitted_by!=reviewer_two
    other,draft -> submitted,true,true,true,true,true
  # Approve a submitted expense from another teammate, optionally recording a note. @{nl="Keur een ingediende onkost van een andere teamgenoot goed en leg desgewenst een toelichting vast."}
  scenario approve(expense:Expense,note:text? label=label_Expense_decision_note) by=reviewer label="Approve expense"@{nl="Onkost goedkeuren"}
   require expense.status==submitted and expense.submitted_by!=actor
   do set expense {status=approved,decision_note=note,decided_by=actor,decided_at=now}
   examples expense=pending
    as,expense.status,expense.submitted_by -> expense.status,expense.decided_by
    reviewer,submitted,other -> approved,self
    reviewer,draft,other -> error(rule_failed)
    members,submitted,other -> error(forbidden)
    reviewer,submitted,self -> error(rule_failed)
   ## Either distinct provisioned reviewer can act; the other keeps its grant.
   examples expense=pending seed=[reviewer_one,reviewer_two]
    as -> expense.status,expense.decided_by,reviewer(reviewer_one),reviewer(reviewer_two)
    reviewer_one -> approved,reviewer_one,true,true
    reviewer_two -> approved,reviewer_two,true,true
   ## Proposed shared-state syntax; the initial parser/runner does not implement it.
   ## Each call uses real authorization and a separate committed transaction.
   examples seed=[reviewer_one,reviewer_two]
    do
     call Expense.create {purpose="Travel",amount=money(25,"EUR")} by=other
     let draft_claim=first(Expense as claim where claim.submitted_by==other)
     draft_claim!=null -> true
     let original_version=draft_claim.version
     call submit {expense=draft_claim} by=other
     let submitted_claim=first(Expense as claim where claim.id==draft_claim.id)
     submitted_claim!=null -> true
     submitted_claim.status -> submitted
     call approve {expense=submitted_claim} by=other -> error(forbidden)
     submitted_claim.status -> submitted
     call approve {expense=submitted_claim} by=reviewer_one request={expense={version=original_version}} -> error(conflict)
     call approve {expense=submitted_claim} by=reviewer_one
     let approved_claim=first(Expense as claim where claim.id==draft_claim.id)
     approved_claim!=null -> true
     approved_claim.status,approved_claim.decided_by -> approved,reviewer_one
     call approve {expense=approved_claim} by=reviewer_two -> error(rule_failed)
     approved_claim.status,approved_claim.decided_by -> approved,reviewer_one
  # Reject a submitted expense from another teammate and explain the decision. @{nl="Wijs een ingediende onkost van een andere teamgenoot af en leg de beslissing uit."}
  scenario reject(expense:Expense,note:text label=label_Expense_decision_note) by=reviewer label="Reject expense"@{nl="Onkost afwijzen"}
   require expense.status==submitted and expense.submitted_by!=actor and trim(note)!=""
   do set expense {status=rejected,decision_note=note,decided_by=actor,decided_at=now}
 Then
  # Prepare expenses and follow their review status. @{nl="Bereid onkosten voor en volg hun beoordelingsstatus."}
  page / title="Expenses"@{nl="Onkosten"}
   breadcrumbs
   card "Prepare an expense"@{nl="Een onkost voorbereiden"}
    form Expense.create
     input purpose
     input amount
     ## submitted_by is server-owned and never editable.
   card "Review status and decisions"@{nl="Beoordelingsstatus en besluiten"}
    list Expense order=-created filter=status defaults={status=preferences.status} display=split empty="No expenses yet"@{nl="Nog geen onkosten"}
     badge row.status
     text row.purpose,row.amount,row.submitted_by
     edit
     action submit
     alert
      require row.status==rejected
      text row.decision_note
     divider "Review decision"@{nl="Beoordelingsbesluit"}
     text row.decision_note,row.decided_by,row.decided_at
     join
      button opens=approve_expense
      button opens=reject_expense
     modal "Approve expense"@{nl="Onkost goedkeuren"} id=approve_expense
      slot content
       form approve arguments={expense=row} display=inline
        textarea note
     modal "Reject expense"@{nl="Onkost afwijzen"} id=reject_expense
      slot content
       form reject arguments={expense=row} display=inline
        textarea note
     history
     pagination
package reporting label="Expense reports"@{nl="Onkostenrapporten"}
 use expenses {Expense}
 Given
  preferences { status:Expense.status=submitted }
  contract Summary { count:int, total:money } label="Expense totals"@{nl="Onkostentotalen"}
  fixture mine=Expense {purpose="Travel",amount=money(25,"EUR"),submitted_by=self,status=submitted}
 When
  # Summarize expenses you can read, in one currency and status. @{nl="Vat leesbare onkosten samen in één valuta en status."}
  scenario summarize(currency:currency,status:Expense.status) read=true -> Summary by=members label="Summarize expenses"@{nl="Onkosten samenvatten"}
   do
    let selected=Expense as expense where expense.amount.currency==currency and expense.status==status
    return Summary {count=count(selected),total=sum(selected as expense select expense.amount,currency)}
   examples seed=[mine] currency="EUR"
    status -> result.count,result.total
    submitted -> 1,money(25,"EUR")
    approved -> 0,money(0,"EUR")
 Then
  # Choose a currency and status to total the expenses visible to you. @{nl="Kies een valuta en status om de voor jou zichtbare onkosten op te tellen."}
  page /reports title="Expense summary"@{nl="Onkostenoverzicht"}
   breadcrumbs
   card "Visible expenses by currency and status"@{nl="Zichtbare onkosten per valuta en status"}
    tabs preferences.status
    form summarize arguments={status=preferences.status} display=inline
     input currency
     ## status binds the selected tab.
     stat result.count,result.total
